"""Run the existing completion controls with one native process at a time."""

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/kernel-public-leaf-endpoints-20261024/diagnostics/extensions-20261024")
import completion_smoke as controls

read_frame = controls.read_frame


def observe_ready(stream):
    frame = read_frame(stream)
    if isinstance(frame, dict) and frame.get("op") == "ready":
        print(json.dumps({"runtimeReady": {key: frame.get(key) for key in
                                         ("protocol", "backend_version", "adapter_version")}}))
    return frame


controls.read_frame = observe_ready
environment = dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
backend = Path(controls.__file__).with_name("backend.py")
with controls.Port(backend, environment) as port:
    for dimension in (0, 1, 4):
        for typed in (False, True):
            controls.finite_checks(port, dimension, typed)
    controls.dual_and_polynomial_checks(port)
    controls.series_checks(port)
    controls.aut_wrapper_checks(port)
    controls.named_aut_checks(port, False)
    controls.named_aut_checks(port, True)
    controls.category_descriptor_checks(port)
    selected = controls.node("obj.sets.fin", 4)
    value = controls.owned(port.request(
        "ownership/original whole map", "mor.sets.fin_rev",
        controls.invoke("mor.sets.fin_rev", [4], selected, selected, selected,
                        controls.identity(selected))))
    controls.cartesian_check(port)
    primary_requests = port.requests

with controls.Port(backend, environment) as foreign:
    foreign.request("ownership/foreign session reuse", "mor.sets.fin_rev",
                    controls.invoke("mor.sets.fin_rev", [4], selected, selected, selected, value),
                    expected="unsupported")
    foreign_requests = foreign.requests

print(json.dumps({"engineering_groups_completed": 14, "engineering_groups_requested": 14,
                  "primary_connection_requests": primary_requests,
                  "foreign_connection_requests": foreign_requests,
                  "engineering_exceptions": [],
                  "scheduling": "original owner closes before the foreign owner starts"}, indent=2))
